llm.summary: This is an instruction-only audit skill whose requirements and instructions are internally consistent with its stated purpose (scanning and scoring SKILL.md files); it asks for no credentials, doesn't install code, and its file/network access is proportional to auditing tasks.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the behavior: the SKILL.md is a detailed audit protocol for evaluating SKILL.md files. There are no unrelated env vars, binaries, or install steps requested — everything present (readme, examples, references) supports the stated auditing purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions tell the agent to locate and read SKILL.md files (local paths under home dirs and repo paths) and, if needed, to fetch a raw SKILL.md from GitHub via curl. Reading skill files and associated resources is appropriate for an audit tool, but this does require the agent to access files under user home directories and optionally perform network fetches — users should expect the tool to read those files and review any fetched remote content before trusting results.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files: lowest-risk installation model. Everything is instruction-only, so nothing is written to disk by an installer step.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The SKILL.md references common skill directories (e.g., ~/.openclaw, ~/.claude) which is consistent with its purpose and does not request unrelated secrets or system-wide credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no self-modifying install behavior. The skill does not request elevated or persistent privileges and does not modify other skills' configurations in the provided materials.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and appropriate for auditing SKILL.md files. Things to consider before installing or granting autonomous access: (1) the audit reads local skill directories (e.g., ~/.openclaw, ~/.claude, repo paths) — ensure you are comfortable with the agent reading those files; (2) it may fetch SKILL.md from remote GitHub raw URLs (curl) when a local copy isn't provided — verify the remote source before allowing network fetches; (3) because it runs autonomously by default, limit its access to only directories you want audited and avoid granting it any credentials or write permissions; (4) review the audit output manually, since the tool inspects content but does not itself enforce sandboxing or prevent exfiltration if you later adapt it to run external code.
